svg.title: USAF aide de camp aiguillette cord (silver, single loop, chrome tip)
svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"cord-aide-de-camp","name":"USAF aide de camp aiguillette cord (silver, single loop, chrome tip)","size_in":{"w":5,"h":8.9},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,500,890],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Not dimensioned in CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903. Shoulder run 4.2 in matches the garment shoulder seam; loop length ~7.4 in and tip ~1.15 in are estimates of a ceremonial single-loop aiguillette","provenance":"in-house construction from DAFI 36-2903 10.7.7.1 (\"silver, single loop, chrome tip with raised wing and star emblem\"); same braid as the shoulder cords","colours":{"main":"#cdd2d7","groove":"#7f8790","tip":"#e6e9ec"},"anchors":{"top_center":[250,0],"bottom_center":[250,890],"center":[250,445],"left_edge":[0,445],"right_edge":[500,445],"shoulder_seam_attach":[450,20],"shoulder_seam_attach_neck_end":[80,20],"shoulder_seam_attach_arm_end":[450,20],"loop_bottom":[57.99999999999999,738],"tip_end":[57.99999999999999,875]},"dimensions":{"form":"aiguillette, single loop with chrome tip","shoulder_run_in":4.2,"loop_length_in":7.4,"thickness_in":0.3,"orientation":"top run lies along the left shoulder seam (arm end at the right of the asset, neck end at the left); the loop then hangs down the chest"},"garment_fit":{"note":"strap axis = line from the neck end to the arm end of the garment's left epaulet strap / shoulder strip (garment user units, 0.01 in; wearer's left shoulder is on the viewer's right). Place: centre the cord on the axis with shoulder_seam_attach_neck_end at the neck end, rotate so the neck->arm anchors follow the axis, shift the chord 0.125 in toward the neck side so the 0.25 in bow is centred on the strap; draw order garment, layers, cord, then the epaulet sleeve/strip over it","class_a_coat":{"asset":"garment-blues-class-a-coat","left_shoulder_seam_in":5.04,"strap_axis":[[1652,244],[2022,341]],"strap_len_in":3.82,"note":"strap from the garment-blues-class-a-cadet-officer-insignia shoulder-strip-left"},"class_a_coat_female":{"asset":"garment-blues-class-a-coat-female","strap_axis":[[1656.5,191],[2008.5,265]],"strap_len_in":3.6,"note":"strap from garment-blues-class-a-cadet-officer-insignia-female shoulder-strip-left"},"class_b_shirt":{"asset":"garment-blues-class-b-shirt-male","left_shoulder_seam_in":4.1,"strap_axis":[[1368.2,193.3],[1775.4,345]],"strap_len_in":4.35,"note":"epaulet_left landmark: pointed neck end to the mid of the arm end"},"class_b_blouse_female":{"asset":"garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female","strap_axis":[[1332.6,203.8],[1777.9,305.9]],"strap_len_in":4.57,"note":"epaulet_left landmark: pointed neck end to the mid of the arm end"}},"mounts":[{"uniform":"USAF-style service and service dress (Class A / Class B) - aides de camp to general officers (senior and cadet)","rule":"worn on the left sleeve/shoulder only while acting as an aide de camp; open end grounded under the epaulet at the left shoulder seam (CAPR 39-1 9.3.4; DAFI 36-2903 10.7.7.1)"}],"regulation":"CAPR 39-1 9.3.4; DAFI 36-2903 10.7.7.1","grade":"cord"}
